text_block_list.text:
The members write lyrics for the Grand 
Live song. Wanting to call out to the fans 
and hear them respond, a proposal to 
include a call-and-response is made.

Hearing that, Light Hello murmured that 
this was why the Umamusume who created the 
Grand Live chose the method of "singing."

Umamusume and fans can't run side-by-side, 
but through singing, they can raise their 
voices together. Through song, they can 
"connect" with their fans.

On the way home, a phrase from her 
conversation with the other members 
suddenly crossed her mind. It was—
choice_data_list:
"A song where we can call out to each 
other," huh...
"Gratitude for being able to run," huh...
